Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner swapped the directors’ birthdates—assigning 1929-12-21 to Jean Yarbrough and 1900-08-22 to Takhir Sabirov—then concluded the wrong film. The correct data (Yarbrough: 1900-08-22; Sabirov: 1929-12-21) shows Leave It to Henry’s director was born first, but the misattribution led to the incorrect final answer.
